title: Scam
body: UltiSelf is a scam! I used it for just a week and stopped because it’s useless — just a basic habit tracker. Three months later I discovered they’d been charging me without any emails or receipts. It’s almost impossible to cancel. Don’t trust this app!
author: Biranika

title: Seems like a scam. Avoid.
body: Been trying to cancel the subscription by sending email for over a week. No response. Very poor customer service. Im probably forced to block my credit card because of this. Dont subscribe to them.

title: this attachment steals your money
body: I installed this app and paid about 15 euros. The payment was not made through the official store. There is no subscription in the app store, it is not possible to cancel the subscription in the app. After a while I saw that the app stole another 39.95 dollars. I had to block the card. The support service does not respond. It is impossible to cancel the subscription. An app for stealing your money

title: Scam
body: Do not even think about installing this app; it’s a scam. They charge you money even after you delete your account. They don’t respond to emails or messages and continue to deduct annual subscription fees monthly.
